name: Yifei (Jeffrey) Sun
description: Yifei Sun is an undergraduate in Data Science and Big Data Technology at Shanghai University of Electric Power, working across AI-assisted learning, assistive navigation, and data science.
about: Yifei Sun studies Data Science and Big Data Technology at Shanghai University of Electric Power, with a GPA of 3.87/4.0 and a major rank of 1/48 in the junior year and cumulatively.
Work spans AI-assisted education, assistive navigation, AI document tools, statistical modeling, and streaming data systems. Yifei Sun is a second author on a paper published in ACCTCS 2025.

publications.title: Bronze Mirror Texture Restoration Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network

experience.title: Software Development Intern, Early Engineering Team
details: Early-stage EdTech startup founded by a Shanghai Jiao Tong University professor and Ph.D. students.
Designed database schemas, permission rules, and task and version states for Codo (React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI), a K–12 AI teaching platform used in 10+ schools in Anhui, China.
Developed parts of the textbook ingestion pipeline, splitting parsed textbooks into chapter trees and section chunks and linking knowledge-graph concepts to supporting passages.

Built the teacher review flow for generated slides, including per-slide rewrites with version history, highlighting during narrated playback, and editable PPTX export; refined the experience using user feedback.
Compared chapter scoping, one-hop graph expansion, and embedding retrieval with LLM reranking to diagnose scripts that drifted from teacher-selected concepts.
Mentor: Prof. Junchi Yan, School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

experience.title: Software Development Assistant (AI)
details: Co-designed the relational database layer for an enterprise Text-to-SQL system, building business tables and query interfaces and documenting the business meaning of each table and field.
Implemented multi-step agent workflows to interpret user intent, generate schema-aware SQL, run queries against the business database, and format results.
Connected backend query services to the frontend result view and used end-to-end tests to catch queries that ran successfully but mapped business terms to the wrong fields.

projects.title: ARIADNE Assistive Navigation
details: Led a five-person team building an assistive navigation prototype for people with visual impairments, integrating tactile-paving detection, map routes, voice guidance, and family messaging.
Organized annotation of 1,000+ tactile-paving images and expanded the dataset to 6,000+ through augmentation; trained YOLOv8 for local alignment and used Baidu routes for turn guidance.
Implemented a shared speech scheduler with priorities, expiry times, and route/state checks, so urgent alerts can interrupt ongoing messages and obsolete turn cues are discarded after rerouting.
Built a RouterAgent to direct natural-language requests to a ReAct map agent backed by Baidu Map MCP or to handlers for settings, family messaging, and companion chat.

projects.title: MarkiNote and FinNote
details: Built and open-sourced MarkiNote, a self-hosted AI document workspace (React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI) whose agent uses 11 tools to search, create, edit, and organize documents and research the web; the project earned 100+ GitHub stars.
Connected 19 FinanceMCP financial tools over HTTP and MCP to form FinNote, bringing multi-market data and AI analysis into editable Markdown notes.
Added safeguards for agent edits: writes are off by default, each write needs one-time approval tied to its arguments, and changes are journaled with before-images for rollback.
Handled concurrent edits with content versions and ETag conflict checks; the CV reports 500+ pytest and Vitest tests.

projects.title: NIPT Testing-Window Optimization and Chromosome-Abnormality Classification
details: Modeled gestational-age and BMI effects in 1,082 NIPT measurements from 267 participants using B-spline and mixed-effects regression; optimized BMI-stratified testing windows and assessed sensitivity through Monte Carlo simulation.
Compared Random Forest with logistic regression using participant-level splits to prevent leakage across repeated measurements; Random Forest achieved ROC-AUC 0.885 and abnormal-class F1 0.791.

projects.title: Bronze Mirror Texture Restoration
details: Collected and prepared 4,000+ bronze-mirror images and split source images before augmentation, expanding the dataset to 10,000+ images while keeping derivatives of each source in the same partition.
Trained and evaluated an attention-enhanced DC-GAN restoration model against baselines, achieving PSNR 20.05 and SSIM 0.906.

projects.title: Battery Cycle-Life Prediction and Streaming Analytics
details: Built a battery cycle-life prediction pipeline using approximately 100K cycle-level records from 124 cells; compared ElasticNet, Random Forest, and XGBoost using cell-level train/test splits, with XGBoost reaching R² 0.89 on held-out cells.
Turned the batch workflow into a streaming prototype by replaying 12M+ battery telemetry events through Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming into HDFS, with checkpointing and deduplication.
Processed out-of-order sensor data in Flink with event-time watermarks and tumbling windows, and ran the offline model in PyFlink using exported preprocessing and model parameters.
